newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Jan 4.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has directed the officials concerned to ensure smooth distribution of fertiliser across the country during the current rice cultivation season.

Development of bilateral trade and increased UK investment in industry and energy sector in Bangladesh will figure prominently in official talks during the forthcoming visit of British Prime Minister John Major.
The U.S. ambassadors in South Asian countries are likely to meet in Bangladesh for a three-day consultation from January 25, diplomatic sources said.
Opposition Bangladesh Nationlist Party (BNP) Secretary General Abdul Mannan Bhuiyan on Friday asked the party leaders and workers to be ready for a massive anti-govenment agitation.
Bangladesh on Friday got back 180 yards of land from India along the border of Nirmal Char village of Rajshahi district which had earlier been captured by the Indian Border Security Forces (BSF).
Major donor agencies and countries are unhappy over Bangladesh's poor performanvce in project implementation, and have asked for improving the situation.
Cargo handling in the Chittagong port has been badly affected due to "go-slow" tactics of the dock workers since Wednesday.
